author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹಾಡುವಾತನ ರಾಗ ತಾಳ ಲಯವಿಲ್ಲದಿರೆ
ಮೋಡಿಮಾಡಲು ಅವಗೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗುವುದೇ
ನಾಡಿಮಿಡಿತವನರಿತು ಅದರಂತೆ ನಡೆಯುತಿರೆ
ಕೂಡಿಪರು ದನಿಗಳನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If a singer has no rāga, tāḷa or laya,
can he ever cast a spell?
if you know the pulse and act in step with it,
people will join their voices with yours, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A song without melody, beat and tempo moves no one. In life too, sense the rhythm of people and situations and act in tune with it, and others will join you.
